title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure.
summary: Treatment of acute HF is based on diuretics for congestion, inotropes, and short-term MCS for peripheral hypoperfusion. Patients hospitalized for HF should be carefully evaluated to exclude persistent signs of congestion. Oral treatment should beoptimized before discharge.

title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure: A Report of the American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association Joint Committee on Clinical Practice Guidelines.
summary: In patients hospitalized with HF, severity of congestion and adequacy of perfusion should be assessed to guide triage and initial therapy. Patients with significant fluid overload should receive intravenous loop diuretics. Cardiogenic shock requires intravenous inotropic support to maintain systemic perfusion and preserve end-organ performance.
